notes.title: Chapter 4 Development Complete!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Bahaku took Akuro to buy new clothes and books, teaching Akuro how to write their own name. Akuro's injuries were gradually improving, and they were about to embark on a new journey![/p][p][/p][p]The game introduction video has been updated, featuring content from Chapters 1-4.
